title: Warehouse Inventory Microservice

_meta.purpose: Machine-readable PRD for the Warehouse Inventory Microservice (inventory-and-warehouse-execution) flat single-concern microservice foundation; metadata-only scope with explicit non-claims.

goals.scalability: Independent horizontal scaling per ADR-0348 (autosharding/auto-rebalance); tenant- and cell-scoped writes with no shared mutable global state. Foundation scope: metadata-only, no measured scaling evidence.
goals.security: Default-deny tenant isolation via Cedar (ADR-0243) and tenant-as-scope (ADR-0244); no raw credential/PII/secret bytes in the domain. Foundation scope: no runtime authentication.
goals.performance: Per-manifest SLO and capacity targets (ADR-0340) required before any GA claim; async-first eventing on Pulsar. Foundation scope: no measured SLO.
goals.efficiency: FinOps cost attribution (ADR-0344) and flat single-concern crates (ADR-0131/0132) that avoid platform bloat. Foundation scope: no runtime cost telemetry.
goals.reliability: Idempotent metadata operations and rollback-first promotion. Foundation scope: no DR drill evidence.

non_goals: No durable warehouse database, WMS runtime task engine, robot/scanner integration, carrier network call, or shipping label generation.
No procurement three-way match, accounting ledger mutation, payment execution, Workflow execution, statutory filing, runtime audit-chain emission, or cloud deployment.
No SAP EWM, Oracle WMS, or Dynamics warehouse exhaustive parity claim.

acceptance_criteria.given: a procurement purchase order arrives at a warehouse receiving dock
acceptance_criteria.when: the warehouse inventory domain records goods receipt
acceptance_criteria.then: tenant, legal entity, warehouse, item, PO, inbound load, expected quantity, received quantity, quantity variance, unit of measure, PO source ref, receiving evidence, timestamp, idempotency key, state, and explicit false procurement/accounting/durable-write flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: a goods receipt has been recorded
acceptance_criteria.when: putaway is recorded into a storage bin
acceptance_criteria.then: receipt, source location, target bin, item, quantity, remaining capacity, location directive, putaway evidence, stock position identity, and false robotics/durable/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: available stock exists for an outbound order
acceptance_criteria.then: stock position, outbound order, allocation policy, reservation evidence, reserved quantity, available-after-reservation, pick-release flag, and false carrier/cloud flags are present while over-reservation is refused

pick task, reservation, outbound order, bin, item, picked quantity, pick evidence, shipment-release flag, and false carrier-call/shipping-label/cloud flags are present; inactive reservation and picked/reserved quantity mismatch are refused

acceptance_criteria.given: cycle counting compares book and counted inventory
acceptance_criteria.then: variance, tolerance, within-tolerance flag, count evidence, and false accounting-adjustment/durable-write/cloud flags are present; variance outside tolerance is refused

acceptance_criteria.given: untrusted identifiers, source refs, evidence refs, units, or quantities enter the warehouse domain
acceptance_criteria.then: prefix-only, traversal, whitespace/control, credential-shaped refs, zero operational quantities, invalid units of measure, capacity shortage, over-reservation, and pick mismatch are refused

decision_log.decision: Warehouse enters the enterprise microservice set as a flat inventory domain crate rather than a monolithic ERP/EWM module; SAP MM/EWM and WMS-like coverage is mapped through Tenant RBAC parity composition while persistence, WMS runtime task execution, robotics/scanner I/O, carrier networks, accounting mutation, Workflow execution, runtime audit emission, and cloud deployment remain explicit non-claims.
